why: Zach (2026-10-19): the kill test for claim 1 (lookup-used bridges carried outside the J-space), the 2x2 and the tie-break (BLR vs BRL), on the suite, scored by the answer read
sample: per scene group, up to 150 scenes eligible (every prompt right) in all of the run's families of the group, seed 0; BL/BR/RL/RR and BLR/BRL are scene groups, other families their own
format: suite_v1's: chat template, thinking off, 'Answer:' prefilled

groups.question: the question's tokens after C's changed ones, through the end of the prompt (the instruction, the template's tokens and 'Answer:' included)

read: one forward of the edited prompt, a digit answer's space token appended; role of the top token (b: X's answer, A: the bridge's, other); ld = logit(b) - logit(A); frac = (ld - ld_clean) / (ld_C - ld_clean), ld_clean and ld_C from the unedited clean and C runs
question: Where, by layer and position group, does each family carry its bridge (lens-free)?
validation: 8 greedy tokens for every edit of the first 20 cases per family; agreement of roles

decision.window: per family and group: the layers where C's copy moves the answer at least 0.1 of the way to C's (mean frac) and further than O's copy (paired bootstrap 95% lower bound of frac_C - frac_O above 0). Chosen after the smoke run (8 scenes), before any full run: exp09's flip rule (C's flips vs O's changes, Wilson intervals apart) found BL only at layers 52-60, above the answer onset, while the copy already moved BL's answer 11-17% of the way at 32-40; the flip rule's windows are reported as windows_flip
decision.answer_formed: per family, the first layer at which copying the last token alone gives X's answer for at least half the cases
decision.parts_window: the question group's window below min(answer_formed, 44)
